newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest sells lots to PLDT, San Miguel.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest sells lots to PLDT, San Miguel.

text.p: Filinvest Development Corp said on Friday it sold about 3.5 hectares of land to San Miguel Corp and Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) in the first quarter of the year.

San Miguel bought 1.903 hectares, while PLDT bought 1.60 hectares in the 224-hectare Filinvest Corporate City, south of Manila, a Filinvest official told reporters. However, she declined to give the purchase prices.
San Miguel officials said it would build an office building, while PLDT said it would use the land to build its local exchange office in the area being billed as the country's next business district.
Filinvest is building a shopping mall, medical centre, international hotels, residential apartments and office condominiums in the city.
Filinvest Development and its subsidiary Filinvest Land Inc are the major owners and developers of Filinvest Corporate City. -- Manila Newsroom (63 2) 841-8938 Fax 817-6267
